scope: Finite source-only verification of all declared macro named-route targets and explicit existing-location references; no worldwide shoreline or regional-interior certification.
known_scope_limits: Approved macro conventions remain geographic/administrative reporting choices, not surveyed physical divides.
The 49 finite-river measurement limits do not establish 49 assignment errors or physical confirmations.
Broad shoreline search-window omissions/offsets require regional source corroboration; raw observations are not missing-island counts.
Blenheim/Speakers marine reef evidence and high-water source uncertainty remain explicit; no positive-area land is invented.
Regional interiors and historical attribute imports remain separately gated.
